corrections.sourceStanding: Literal game report retained; household Internet ubiquity is not inferred.
corrections.acquisitionBoundary: A person must acquire the report through evidenced reading or communication. Personal service use and locally observed failure are separate narrower knowledge.
corrections.temporalBoundary: Hours-long and ongoing at publication does not establish recovery after hours.
corrections.computerIntegration: An installed computer mod or owned device supplies no knowledge. A future adapter must identify the person, endpoint, service, access and actual result; reported content keeps its source and reception time.
